command_executed: ./websearch --no-cache -m reason "What is the correct way to initialize a TypeScript Express API project with strict ESM mode, tsx for development, esbuild for production bundling, and OpenAPI schema generation from Zod validators that stays in sync with route handlers"

evaluation.summary: 2.5/5.0 - Covers the right tools superficially but skips all the hard ESM integration details
evaluation.key_strengths: Provides a working skeleton covering all four requested tools (tsx, esbuild, ESM tsconfig, Zod/OpenAPI) with correct package install commands and a valid package.json scripts block.
evaluation.key_weaknesses: Misses the core difficulty entirely: no esbuild ESM output flags, no zod-to-openapi registry/route integration, no guidance on strict ESM import extensions, and deflects to unrelated frameworks (Hono/Elysia) rather than solving the Express problem.
